title: Steady sideslip (directional and lateral static stability)
objective: To demonstrate that the simulator exhibits the correct inter-relationship of steady state lateral/directional flight characteristics in conformance with the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 1.5º sideslip angle (beta) | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% rudder position | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% wheel position | ± 2º bank angle
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
